episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the integration of AI in luxury real estate, emphasizing the importance of local knowledge and relationship building. She shares practical tactics for using AI to anticipate client needs and create targeted marketing strategies. The conversation highlights how AI can enhance but not replace the expertise of skilled REALTORS.
